in_marathi.name: Hrudaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Source of the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrudaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The term Hrudaya comes from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words - 'hru' meaning heart and 'daya' meaning compassion. Thus, Hrudaya is the one who embodies compassion from the heart. In Hindu mythology, Hrudaya is often associated with the goddess of compassion, Goddess Saraswati. It is believed that a person named Hrudaya is a symbol of love, kindness, and compassion.
